source_boundary: Ambient dialogue is original fiction inspired by documented humour mechanisms. Published Kevin MacLeod recordings are admitted separately with source/licence records. No verified or cleared protest-voice recording is included.
performance_rules: One vignette at a time; 16–28-second gap after completion.
Named cast must be physically nearby; single-character scenes can occur independently.
Two opt-in interjections appear only from 2 to 9.5 seconds and within six metres.
Interjection effects commit after the reply, at eleven seconds.
Pursuit, another conversation, missing cast or walking away from an opted-in exchange interrupts without reward.
Each scene plays at most twice; a three-minute cooldown and changed opening provide a callback.
Higher tension suppresses comic vignettes; quiet journalist scene can appear later.
audio_rules: Reuses existing user-started Soundtrack AudioContext and effects/master routing.
Published music selected through approved local recording manifest; calm and chase moods crossfade.
Legacy procedural score and DayPresentation synthetic motifs disabled by default; physical interaction SFX remain.
No generated stings substitute for missing recorded cue assets.
Browser synthetic voice preview defaults off; legacy automatic-speech preferences migrate off.
Recorded voices require exact actor/line mapping to admitted recordings; current voice manifest is empty.
Distance attenuates recordings, voices duck music, pause/mute cancels playback and pending downloads cannot restart disabled music.
Optional browser preview selection and volume persist; overlapping own utterances have bounded queue and expiry.

root_hooks.effect: event => apply small aura/trust and persistent callback only after scene reply
root_hooks.crowd: event => optional small local reaction; not universal cheering

validation_limits: Headless tests verify scheduling, locality, action windows, persistence and cancellation. Human voice quality, music balance, spatial gestures and frame rate require browser listening/viewing.
